scope: six existing finite NPU prefill-from-zero training searches; read-only evidence consolidation; no experiments rerun

statistics.throughput: actual B*L input positions / median seconds
statistics.stability: sample range / median <= 0.25; finite heuristic, not confidence interval
statistics.search_stop: predeclared doubling axis candidates exhausted in every line; no OOM/budget/time/plateau stop
statistics.performance_ratio: Tide / Transformer elapsed time at the same B/L; > 1 means Tide takes longer

matching.parameter_scope: Transformer main blocks and final RMSNorm, without embedding/head/artificial unused parameters
matching.selection_rule: exact block count; nearest parameters over d=16*j>=32, FFN=8*j in [2d,6d]; ties prefer FFN=4d
matching.common: per-shape initial audit rematches A-D before updates
matching.capacity: constructors fixed from B32/L128 calibration; no rematching at higher B or after updates
matching.active_definition: unique Parameter scalars in semantically effective owner/group/source slices; not nonzero gradients or physical loads
matching.active_deduplication: sample/input step for Settle/FC; sample/logical tick for Timed with repeated ticks accumulated; no output causal attribution
matching.fixed_history: Transformer window128; Tide logical KV128*period unchanged; L changes stream/BPTT extent

memory.peak: per-process cumulative allocated peak since post-warmup reset, before intrusive post-audit
memory.enforcement: allocator budget checked after synchronized construction/audit/warmup/sample, plus sampled process-tree RSS; no hard reservation
memory.diagnostics: initial semantic/runtime audits and post-update audits excluded from timing; their memory checks still affect admission

resource_scope: six overlapping searches, distinct queue-admitted physical NPUs and disjoint four-CPU affinity; cooperative exclusive queue does not control external jobs or host contention
input_pairing: same seed1107; CPU feature-wise input seed1108; common sample/time/feature prefixes across widths, with actual hashes retained

checks: three finite samples/losses, median, input throughput, range/median and stability
normal allocated peak versus worker record
initial Tide parameter/input hashes versus per-shape audit
FP32 parameter/gradient/moment storage keys and BF16 operator observation
all A-D targets, counts, deviations and legal nearest constructors
capacity fixed constructors and best stable observations
